meta.name: scienceworld-conditional-focus-executor
meta.description: Executes a 'focus on OBJ' action on a specific object based on the outcome of a prior conditional evaluation. Use when you have a measurement result and task instructions specify focusing on different objects (e.g., colored boxes) depending on whether the result meets a threshold.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 根据条件结果聚焦到不同对象
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在科学实验中根据测量结果切换关注对象
copy.tagline_en: Focus on different objects based on conditional outcomes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to switch focus based on measurement results in science experiments

howto.what: 装上后，Claude在ScienceWorld环境中，会根据测量结果（温度、pH或质量）与阈值的比较，自动对符合条件的物体执行“聚焦”动作。例如，温度高于50度则聚焦红盒，否则聚焦蓝盒。
howto.when: 当你完成一个测量（温度、pH或质量）后，任务要求根据测量结果是否满足阈值来决定聚焦哪个对象时触发。

say.text: 温度测量结果是63度，如果高于50度聚焦红盒。
say.note: Claude会判断条件并执行聚焦红盒。

say.text: pH值是7，若小于7聚焦红盒否则聚焦蓝盒。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will automatically execute a 'focus on' action on the object determined by comparing a measurement result (temperature, pH, or mass) against a threshold in ScienceWorld. E.g., if temp >50, focus on red box; else blue.
howto.when_en: Triggers after completing a measurement (temperature, pH, or mass) when the task requires focusing on different objects based on whether the result meets a threshold.

say_en.text: Temperature is 63°C. If above 50, focus on red box.
say_en.note: Claude evaluates and focuses on red box.

say_en.text: pH is 7. Focus on red box if <7, else blue.
Mass is 100g. If >50, focus on green box.
